bullets.text: AI Actions in File Explorer - **Windows 11** introduces AI actions for seamless file interactions, enhancing productivity.
Fluid Dictation Feature - **Copilot+ PCs** now support fluid dictation, improving voice access efficiency.
Mandatory MFA Phase 2 - Starting October 2025, **Azure** enforces multifactor authentication for enhanced security.
Interop 2026 Proposals Open - **Microsoft** invites submissions to enhance web development interoperability.
AI Adoption for US Government - **Microsoft** partners with GSA to accelerate AI tools for federal agencies.
